SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM customer c
JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey AND s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA'
  AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01'
  AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01'
GROUP BY n.n_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC

answer: INDIA had the highest local revenue in 1994 among ASIA nations, at about 536,862,588 (sum of extendedprice * (1 - discount) for line items where customer and supplier are both in India, for orders placed in 1994). Runner-up was CHINA at about 535,350,830.

FROM lineitem l

JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
JOIN nation ns ON ns.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey

  AND r.r_name = 'ASIA'
